title: Northern Qi
capsule: Northern Qi (北齊) was a Chinese dynasty founded in 550 CE by Gao Yang, who deposed the Eastern Wei puppet emperor and ruled from the twin capitals of Ye and Jinyang in the Yellow River basin. Its warrior aristocracy of Xianbei-Xiongnu extraction sponsored lavish Buddhist cave art, such as the Xiangtangshan grottoes, even as a succession of erratic and often short-reigned emperors weakened central control. Locked in constant rivalry with Northern Zhou to its west, Northern Qi was conquered by Zhou forces in 577, reuniting northern China under one throne.
